items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal is linked to a smaller rise in sugar, with the biggest difference seen after dinner. Walking 10 to 19 minutes after dinner got most of the gain, with a rise about 17.5 mg/dL smaller.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Eating dinner at 8 pm or later is linked to a bigger rise in sugar, with dinners from 8-9 pm linked to a rise about 13.3 mg/dL more than earlier dinners. Try to start dinner before 8 pm to see if it makes a difference for you.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: You are already averaging 14.5 hours of overnight fasting, which is a good habit to keep up. Adding an overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points compared with coaching alone in the program.
